query:
select
to_char(registration_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Registration date",
registered_by as "Registered by",
first_name as "First name",
middle_name as "Middle name",
last_name as "Last name",
cultural_name as "Cultural name",
display_id as "Patient ID",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
registration_type as "Registration type",
birth_certificate as "Birth certificate",
driving_license as "Driving license",
passport as "Passport",
blood_type as "Blood type",
title as "Title",
marital_status as "Marital status",
primary_contact_number as "Primary contact number",   -- noqa:disable=LT05
secondary_contact_number as "Secondary contact number",   -- noqa:disable=LT05
country_of_birth as "Country of birth",
nationality as "Nationality",
ethnicity as "Ethnicity",
occupation as "Occupation",
religion as "Religion",
patient_billing_type as "Billing type"
from "reporting"."ds__patients"
where date_of_birth >= 
:fromDate
and
date_of_birth <= 
:toDate
order by date_of_birth, last_name, first_name
name: Registered patients by DOB line list
notes: This report generates a list of all patients that have been registered, including date of registration and which user completed the registration. Patients are listed in chronological order by date of administration. The report also includes key demographic information for each patient.
